summary: Full regression pass: all 11 backend pytest tests pass and end-to-end frontend flow (admin login, sidebar navigation across 8 pages, plan create, member create, member detail + renewal, notifications retry, audit log, payments+receipt links, settings save, admin logout, member portal OTP login, member portal shows real data from /api/member/me, member sign out) succeed. Brute-force lockout now correctly returns 429 after 5 bad admin logins (regression from iteration 3 fixed).

minor.issue: Admin password reconciliation on rotation still not implemented (seed only inserts when absent). Cosmetic; documented in prior report.

issues: React hydration console warning: <span> cannot be child of <option>. Caused by preview runtime's x-source instrumentation wrapping each option's text in a <span>; does not affect functionality but pollutes console.

action_items: (Optional) Make seed idempotently update the admin password if env-configured credentials rotate.
(Optional) Reconcile the <option> children so the preview instrumentation cannot inject a <span> child (e.g., avoid inline JSX expressions inside <option>). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Brute-force lockout implemented correctly in routers.login using db.login_attempts with 5 failures -> 15 min lock.
Member portal is now data-driven from /api/member/me via httpOnly member_token cookie; days_remaining, plan, history and payments all render.
APScheduler + dedup_key on notifications delivers per-day idempotency (verified: second /api/jobs/run returns zero counters).
Renewal correctly extends from the current expiry when today < expiry (verified via test_renewal_extends_before_expiry_does_not_shrink).
